t: Communication 20-8-41 From The Office Of The Press Attache, British Embassy, Concerning Anatoly Innkentievich Sotnikoff

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Special Branch Station. File No. Date August 29, 1941.

SUBJECT: Confidential communication dated 20-8-41 from
the Office of the Press Attache, British Embassy,
concerning A.I. SOTNIKOFF.

Inquiries show that the correct name of the in-
dividual referred to in the attached communication is
Anatoly Innokentievich SOTNIKOFF. He is a Russian who
was born on May 15, 1917 in Yakutsk Province, Siberia.
According to his own statement, he escaped from the
U.S.S.R. to Manchuria in December, 1930. and subsequent-
ly resided in Harbin. In October, 1937 he arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin travelling on passport No. 21899
issued by the Harbin Police on 25-12-37. A wireless
operator by occupation he is reported to have been em-
ployed in this capacity with Moller's Ltd and later with
Wheelock & Co., Ltd until April, 1939 when he left for
Japan, reportedly, being engaged by the Higuchi Co, Kobe.
Returning here from Japan some time towards the end of
1940 he has since been residing at 112-B Route Vallon.

Who

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee, Moulmein Road, but has not been there since March,
1937. His mother, Mrs A.S. Sotnikoff is reported to have
been employed with Kunst & Albers in Harbin. His bro-
ther V.I. Sotnikoff has been a member of the Russian
Auxiliary Detachment, French Police, since August, 1937.
While in Shanghai Sotnikoff did not come to Po-
lice notice.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

特别巡捕房站。档案编号。日期：1941年8月29日。

主题：英国大使馆新闻专员办公室于1941年8月20日发出的关于A.I. SOTNIKOFF的机密函件。

经查，附件函件中所述人员的正确姓名为Anatoly Innokentievich SOTNIKOFF。他是俄罗斯人，1917年5月15日出生于西伯利亚雅库茨克省。据其自述，他于1930年12月从苏联逃往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨。1937年10月，他持哈尔滨警察机关于1937年12月25日签发的第21899号护照，从哈尔滨抵达上海。他的职业是无线电报务员，据悉他曾以此身份受雇于马勒有限公司（Moller's Ltd），后受雇于怡和洋行有限公司（Wheelock & Co., Ltd），直至1939年4月前往日本，据称受雇于神户樋口公司（Higuchi Co, Kobe）。他于1940年底某时从日本返回此地，此后一直居住在法租界华伦路（Route Vallon）112-B号。

他已在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）的俄侨委员会登记，但自1937年3月以来未再去过那里。据悉，其母A.S. Sotnikoff夫人曾在哈尔滨的昆斯特与阿尔伯斯公司（Kunst & Albers）任职。其兄V.I. Sotnikoff自1937年8月起一直是法国警察辖下的俄罗斯辅助分队成员。Sotnikoff在上海期间并未引起警方注意。
